shared_elements: horizontal register divider separating upper and lower scenes
border/edge band of repeated motifs framing the field
relief/outline figures set against a plain field on an upright slab
justification: Both are upright slabs with figural imagery divided into an upper and a lower zone by a horizontal line, with a framing band of repeated elements along the edge and animals shown in profile; that is about where the correspondence ends. A shows isolated schematic animals (feline-like beast, crouching figure, birds, scorpion-like creature) with no interaction and no human riders, while B shows a horse with attendant human figures in the upper field and dense interlaced serpentine knotwork below, a wholly different repertoire and rendering convention.
